title: FInders Keepers
tagline: Social NFT marketplace where listings are shared with everyone using lens protocol
description: This project uses Lens protocol to help discover listings on the zora platform. We listen to listings and allow users to share the information on our FInders Keepers community @lens Finder's fees can be either paid to a community multisig or be purchased by anyone by changing ownership of the original post
how_its_made:
We created a front end where data is queried from comments on a lens community. the idea is to use that as the database for the platform listings and incentivize users to share their finds. 

Listings are listened on the Zora protocol and shown to the user who can then create a comment on the lens community with the listing details.

These posts can be tallied to pay users for promoting FK's listings
